parts.text: Researchers don’t know enough yet about
fat to know why it is in just a few parts of the body. It is possible that it’s near the neck and around major blood vessels to help insulate the blood and keep overall body

in a healthy warm range.

As for white fat, there appear to be three main factors that determine where your fat gets stored: genetics, hormones and age.

Certain genes direct fat to accumulate in the butt, while other genes tell it to

on the torso.

Hormones like estrogen, which affects almost every system in all bodies but is typically higher in females, direct more subcutaneous fat to

in the butt, thighs and backs of the arms. Cortisol, the stress hormone, seems to direct visceral fat to accumulate in the belly area.

But why isn’t fat evenly
throughout the body? Well, having a lot of fat around your elbows and knees would limit your ability to bend your arms and legs. Storing a lot of fat around your head would
put your brain at risk of overheating. Other parts of your body, like hips, butts, breasts and thighs, don’t have these risks – maybe that’s why we

fat there.

Why do people have fat at all?

reading.title: 主旨、理解与信息定位
reading.instruction: 阅读原文后回答 5 道选择题：1 道主旨、1 道内容理解、1 道段落细节、2 道信息定位。段落细节题以题干指定段落为准。

questions.prompt: Which statement best summarises the overall focus of this article?
options: The location and function of body fat help explain why fat is stored around the buttocks.
New research explores a way to repair heart tissue damaged by a heart attack.
Research compares heat and cold as approaches to recovery after exercise.
Mammograms may reveal information about cardiovascular health as well as breast cancer.
questions.explanation: 把标题与全文各段的中心内容连起来判断主旨，避免把同一主题下的其他话题当成本文重点。
questions.evidence: Hippos only have around 2% body fat, the percentage of how much of your body mass comes from fat; while the average human woman has over 30% body fat.

questions.prompt: How does the article characterise body fat?
options: As an important and changing component of the body
As something found only in modern humans
As an entirely inactive substance with no role
As a material that can never change
questions.explanation: 第 6 段提供了作答依据。正确选项用不同说法表达了文中的信息；请比较范围、数量、因果关系与限定词。
questions.evidence: Fat is an important and constantly changing part of all bodies, including those of humans and our evolutionary ancestors.

questions.prompt: Which of the following statements is explicitly made in paragraph 14?
options: Fat, also called adipose tissue, is one kind of connective tissue that helps hold your body together.
Scientists know that brown fat performs a special function to heat your body when you get cold.
White fat is the kind of fat most people are familiar with and performs the functions mentioned above.
It is only located just above your collar bone and along your major deep blood vessels, like your aorta.
questions.explanation: 定位第 14 段，比较四个选项的具体信息。其余选项来自本文其他段落，并非本段明确陈述的内容。
questions.evidence: Scientists know that brown fat performs a special function to heat your body when you get cold.

questions.prompt:

“Well, having a lot of fat around your elbows and knees would limit your ability to bend your arms and legs.”
questions.explanation: 这句话位于第 21 段。先找关键词，再核对上下文；正文页显示相同的段落编号。
questions.evidence: Well, having a lot of fat around your elbows and knees would limit your ability to bend your arms and legs.

“These ancient statues from 25,000 to 28,000 years ago depict feminine figures who carry a lot of extra body fat.”
